theorem construction_walsh_definitions (k t : ℕ)
    (z : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t)) :
    (∀ b : Bool, bitSign b = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (if b then (1 : ℕ) else 0)) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (mValue t), walshSign t i j =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (∑ b ∈ range (2 * t),
        if i.val.testBit b && j.val.testBit b then (1 : ℕ) else 0)) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (mValue t), H t i j =
      (Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ))⁻¹ * (walshSign t i j : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin (mValue t), u t i = (Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ))⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ h : Fin k, signDiag z h = Matrix.diagonal fun i => (bitSign (z (h, i)) : ℝ))

        Eq (QuarticQuery.walshSign t i j)
          (HPow.hPow (-1)
            ((Finset.range (HMul.hMul 2 t)).sum fun b => ite (Eq (((↑i).testBit b).and ((↑j).testBit b)) true) 1 0)))
      (And

          Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.H t i j)
            (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt) ↑(QuarticQuery.walshSign t i j)))

            Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.u t i) (Inv.inv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt))
          (∀ (h : Fin k),

        (Z : Type) (instZ : Fintype Z),
        let _ := instZ
        ∃ (o : Z) (out : Z → Bool)
          (F : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t) → Reg Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg Z),
          ((2 * (n * k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ A * (1 + Real.log (1 / η)) ∧
          IsCirc (n * k) F ∧
          (∀ z b, L z b = lawOf (F z (rket o)) out b) ∧
          (∀ z, 0 ≤ L z false ∧ 0 ≤ L z true ∧ L z false + L z true = 1) ∧
          (∀ z b, P k t z = some b → 1 - η ≤ L z b) ∧

                ∀ z ψ b, (K next).outputMass z (clEmb emb ψ) b =
                  next.outputMass z (clEmb emb (F z ψ)) b

theorem construction_N_phi (k t : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (z : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t)) :
    (forrelationNumerator k t z : ℝ) =
      (fun _ : Fin (mValue t) => (1 : ℝ)) ⬝ᵥ
        (alternate (W t) (List.ofFn fun h : Fin k => signDiag z h) *ᵥ
          fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    Phi k t z = (forrelationNumerator k t z : ℝ) / (forrelationDenominator k t : ℝ) ∧
    0 < forrelationDenominator k t ∧
    (forrelationDenominator k t : ℝ) =
      (mValue t : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ)) ^ (k - 1) ∧
    W t = Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ) • H t ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (mValue t), W t i j = 1 ∨ W t i j = -1)
source.type_text:

  (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And
    (Eq (↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z))
      (dotProduct (fun x => 1)
        ((QuarticQuery.Forrelation.alternate (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t)
              (List.ofFn fun h => QuarticQuery.Forrelation.signDiag z h)).mulVec
          fun x => 1)))
    (And
      (Eq (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)
        (HDiv.hDiv ↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z) ↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t)))
      (And (LT.lt 0 (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t))
        (And
          (Eq (↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t))
            (HMul.hMul (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (HPow.hPow (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt (HSub.hSub k 1))))
          (And
            (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t)
              (HSMul.hSMul (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.H t)))
            (∀ (i j : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
              Or (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t i j) 1) (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t i j) (-1)))))))

theorem construction_lemma_2_2_complete {k t : ℕ}
    (C : Circuit (ForrelationCoord k t)) (A : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hC : CircuitRealises C (P k t))
    (hS : C.size ≤ A * mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 2) :
    Fintype.card (TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) =
      mValue t + (mValue t - 1) + 40 * t * (C.size + 2) ∧
    Fintype.card (TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) ≤
      (42 + 20 * A) * mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 3 ∧
    (∀ (x : BitInput (Loc k t C)) (i : Column (2 * t)) (s : Address (40 * t)),
      PaperWinsAt (P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s ↔
        ∀ e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size,
          localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e = true) ∧
    (∀ (i : Column (2 * t)) (s : Address (40 * t))
        (e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
      (∀ x, (localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).eval x =
        localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e) ∧
      (localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).depth ≤ 2 * t + 1) ∧
    (∀ (i : Column (2 * t)) (s : Address (40 * t)),
      ∃ (Z : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size → Type)
        (instZ : ∀ e, Fintype (Z e)),
        let _ := instZ
        ∃ (o : ∀ e, Z e) (out : ∀ e, Z e → Bool)
          (F : ∀ e, BitInput (Loc k t C) → Reg (Z e) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg (Z e)),
          (∀ e, IsCirc (max 3 (2 * t + 1)) (F e)) ∧
          IsCirc (max 3 (2 * t + 1)) (fun x => sigmaOp fun e => F e x) ∧
          (∀ (x : BitInput (Loc k t C))
              (a : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size → ℂ)
              (e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
            slice e (sigmaOp (fun e => F e x) (constructionIndexStart o a)) =
              a e • F e x (rket (o e))) ∧
          (∀ (x : BitInput (Loc k t C))
              (e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) (z : Z e),
            out e z ≠ localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e →
              (F e x (rket (o e))).ofLp z = 0) ∧
          ∃ (w : ℕ) (emb : (Σ e, Z e) ↪ Fin (w + 1))
            (P : AdaptiveProgram (Loc k t C) w → AdaptiveProgram (Loc k t C) w),
            ∀ next, (P next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (2 * t + 1) + next.queryCap ∧
              ∀ x ψ b, (P next).outputMass x (clEmb emb ψ) b =
                next.outputMass x
                  (clEmb emb (sigmaOp (fun e => F e x) ψ)) b)

theorem construction_lemma_2_2_complete {k t : ℕ}
    (C : Circuit (ForrelationCoord k t)) (A : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hC : CircuitRealises C (P k t))
    (hS : C.size ≤ A * mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 2) :
    Fintype.card (TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) =
      mValue t + (mValue t - 1) + 40 * t * (C.size + 2) ∧
    Fintype.card (TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) ≤
      (42 + 20 * A) * mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 3 ∧
    (∀ (x : BitInput (Loc k t C)) (i : Column (2 * t)) (s : Address (40 * t)),
      PaperWinsAt (P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s ↔
        ∀ e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size,
          localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e = true) ∧
    (∀ (i : Column (2 * t)) (s : Address (40 * t))
        (e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
      (∀ x, (localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).eval x =
        localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e) ∧
      (localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).depth ≤ 2 * t + 1) ∧
    (∀ (i : Column (2 * t)) (s : Address (40 * t)),
      ∃ (Z : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size → Type)
        (instZ : ∀ e, Fintype (Z e)),
        let _ := instZ
        ∃ (o : ∀ e, Z e) (out : ∀ e, Z e → Bool)
          (F : ∀ e, BitInput (Loc k t C) → Reg (Z e) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg (Z e)),
          (∀ e, IsCirc (max 3 (2 * t + 1)) (F e)) ∧
          IsCirc (max 3 (2 * t + 1)) (fun x => sigmaOp fun e => F e x) ∧
          (∀ (x : BitInput (Loc k t C))
              (a : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size → ℂ)
              (e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
            slice e (sigmaOp (fun e => F e x) (constructionIndexStart o a)) =
              a e • F e x (rket (o e))) ∧
          (∀ (x : BitInput (Loc k t C))
              (e : TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) (z : Z e),
            out e z ≠ localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e →
              (F e x (rket (o e))).ofLp z = 0) ∧
          ∃ (w : ℕ) (emb : (Σ e, Z e) ↪ Fin (w + 1))
            (P : AdaptiveProgram (Loc k t C) w → AdaptiveProgram (Loc k t C) w),
            ∀ next, (P next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (2 * t + 1) + next.queryCap ∧
              ∀ x ψ b, (P next).outputMass x (clEmb emb ψ) b =
                next.outputMass x
                  (clEmb emb (sigmaOp (fun e => F e x) ψ)) b)

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_lemma_2_2_complete {k t : Nat}
  (C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (A : Nat) (ht : LE.le 1 t)
  (hC : QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t))
  (hS : LE.le C.size (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul A (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (HPow.hPow (HMul.hMul 2 t) 2))) :
  And
    (Eq (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size))
      (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (QuarticQuery.mValue t) (HSub.hSub (QuarticQuery.mValue t) 1))
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 40 t) (HAdd.hAdd C.size 2))))
    (And
      (LE.le (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size))
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd 42 (HMul.hMul 20 A)) (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (HPow.hPow (HMul.hMul 2 t) 3)))
      (And
        (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (i : QuarticQuery.Column (HMul.hMul 2 t))
          (s : QuarticQuery.Address (HMul.hMul 40 t)),
          Iff (QuarticQuery.PaperWinsAt (QuarticQuery.P k t) C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) x i s)
            (∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size),
              Eq (QuarticQuery.localTest C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) x i s e) true))
        (And
          (∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (HMul.hMul 2 t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (HMul.hMul 40 t))
            (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size),
            And
              (∀
                (x :
                  QuarticQuery.BitInput
                    (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
                Eq ((QuarticQuery.localTestTree C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) i s e).eval x)
                  (QuarticQuery.localTest C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) x i s e))
              (LE.le (QuarticQuery.localTestTree C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) i s e).depth
                (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 t) 1)))
          (∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (HMul.hMul 2 t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (HMul.hMul 40 t)),
            Exists fun Z =>
              Exists fun instZ =>
                have x := instZ;
                Exists fun o =>
                  Exists fun out =>
                    Exists fun F =>
                      And
                        (∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size),
                          QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (max 3 (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 t) 1)) (F e))
                        (And
                          (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (max 3 (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 t) 1)) fun x_1 =>
                            QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1)
                          (And
                            (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                              (a : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size → Complex)
                              (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size),
                              Eq
                                ((QuarticQuery.Upper.slice e)
                                  ((QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1)
                                    (QuarticQuery.Paper.constructionIndexStart o a)))
                                (HSMul.hSMul (a e) ((F e x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket (o e)))))
                            (And
                              (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size) (z : Z e),
                                Ne (out e z) (QuarticQuery.localTest C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) x_1 i s e) →
                                  Eq (((F e x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket (o e))).ofLp z) 0)
                              (Exists fun w =>
                                Exists fun emb =>
                                  Exists fun P =>
                                    ∀ (next : QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C) w),
                                      And
                                        (LE.le (P next).queryCap
                                          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 t) 1)) next.queryCap))
                                        (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                          (ψ : QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg (Sigma fun e => Z e)) (b : Bool),
                                          Eq ((P next).outputMass x_1 ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b)
                                            (next.outputMass x_1
                                              ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb)
                                                ((QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1) ψ))
                                              b))))))))))

theorem construction_local_dichotomy {κ : Type} {f : PartialBool κ}
    {C : Circuit κ} {ℓ r : ℕ} (hC : CircuitRealises C f)
    (x : BitInput (BitLoc ℓ r C.size κ)) (i : Column ℓ) :
    (constructionWinner f C ℓ r x i →
      ∃ s : Address r, ∀ e : TestIndex ℓ r C.size,
        localTest C ℓ r x i s e = true) ∧
    (¬ constructionWinner f C ℓ r x i →
      ∀ s : Address r, ∃ e : TestIndex ℓ r C.size,
        localTest C ℓ r x i s e = false)

  (i : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ) :

      Exists fun s => ∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex ℓ r C.size), Eq (QuarticQuery.localTest C ℓ r x i s e) true)

theorem quantum_grover_trial_distribution {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≠ 0) :
    (∀ ℓ : Fin M, trialWeight M ℓ =
      (if (ℓ : ℕ) = 0 then 1 / 2 else 0) + 1 / (2 * (M : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : Fin M, 0 ≤ trialWeight M ℓ) ∧
    (∑ ℓ : Fin M, trialWeight M ℓ) = 1

  And
    (∀ (ℓ : Fin M),

        (HAdd.hAdd (ite (Eq (↑ℓ) 0) (1 / 2) 0) (HDiv.hDiv 1 (HMul.hMul 2 ↑M))))
    (And (∀ (ℓ : Fin M), LE.le 0 (QuarticQuery.Amplification.trialWeight M ↑ℓ))
      (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun ℓ => QuarticQuery.Amplification.trialWeight M ↑ℓ) 1))

    (amplify γ η).callCap ≤ trialCount η * (2 * iterationBound γ + 1) ∧

    ∀ {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (A : Preparation H),
      (amplify γ η).successProb A + (amplify γ η).failProb A = 1 ∧
      (∀ h : Option H → ℝ, PhaseInvariant h →
        (amplify γ η).expect A h A.zero =
          (amplify γ η).successProb A * h (some A.goodState) +
          (amplify γ η).failProb A * h none) ∧
      (∀ k : H → ℝ, (∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ = 1 → ∀ v, k (c • v) = k v) →
        (amplify γ η).successProb A ≠ 0 →
        (amplify γ η).conditional A k = k A.goodState) ∧
      (amplify γ η).wrongStateMass A = 0 ∧
      (γ ≤ A.prob → (amplify γ η).failProb A ≤ η) ∧

source.source_header:
theorem quantumDecode_correct (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hn : repetitions k (ε / (40 * t : ℕ)) ≤ n)
    {x : BitInput (Loc k t C)} {i : Col t} {s : Addr t}
    (hs : ∀ h, P k t (readA x i h) = some (s h)) :
    1 - ε ≤ addrLaw n x i s

theorem quantumDecode_query_bound_real (ht : 1 ≤ t) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    ((2 * addrCost k t (repetitions k (ε / (40 * t : ℕ))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      80 * (t : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
        (1 + 16 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (10 * k) * Real.log ((40 * t : ℕ) / ε))

source.type_text:

    (↑(HMul.hMul 2
        (QuarticQuery.Upper.addrCost k t (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.repetitions k (HDiv.hDiv ε ↑(HMul.hMul 40 t))))))
    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 80 ↑t) ↑k)

        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 16 (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul 10 k))) (Real.log (HDiv.hDiv (↑(HMul.hMul 40 t)) ε)))))

rows.current_statement: Comparison of distinct columns, in sorted order: decode each in separate workspaces; read each column's pointer towards the other at its decoded address and inspect the pointed bit of the other's X string. A column disqualifies its opponent if that bit is 0. If exactly one disqualifies the other it is victorious, otherwise the smaller index. A self-comparison returns false without reading a pointer.

theorem quantumComparison_disqualification (x : BitInput (Loc k t C))
    (i : Col t) (s : Addr t) (j : Col t) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    disq x i s j hji =
      !readX x j (pointerEquiv (2 * t) (readPointerBit x i s ⟨j, hji⟩))

  (s : QuarticQuery.Upper.Addr t) (j : QuarticQuery.Upper.Col t) (hji : Ne j i) :
  Eq (QuarticQuery.Upper.disq x i s j hji)
    (QuarticQuery.readX x j
        ((QuarticQuery.pointerEquiv (HMul.hMul 2 t)) (QuarticQuery.readPointerBit x i s ⟨j, hji⟩))).not

source.source_header:
theorem quantumComparison_sorted (n : ℕ) (x : BitInput (Loc k t C))
    (i j : Col t) (hij : i < j) :
    cmpProb n x i j =
      ∑ s₁, addrLaw n x i s₁ * ∑ s₂, addrLaw n x j s₂ *
        (if firstWins (disq x i s₁ j hij.ne')
          (disq x j s₂ i hij.ne) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
context_headers: variable {k t : ℕ} {C : Circuit (ForrelationCoord k t)}
source.type_text:
QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumComparison_sorted {k t : Nat} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)}
  (n : Nat) (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (i j : QuarticQuery.Upper.Col t)
  (hij : LT.lt i j) :
  Eq (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpProb n x i j)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun s₁ =>
      HMul.hMul (QuarticQuery.Upper.addrLaw n x i s₁)
        (Finset.univ.sum fun s₂ =>
          HMul.hMul (QuarticQuery.Upper.addrLaw n x j s₂)
            (ite
              (Eq
                (QuarticQuery.Upper.firstWins (QuarticQuery.Upper.disq x i s₁ j ⋯) (QuarticQuery.Upper.disq x j s₂ i ⋯))
                true)
              1 0)))

theorem quantumComparison_unordered_state (hk : 1 ≤ k) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Col t) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∃ (Z : Type) (_ : Fintype Z) (o : Z) (out : Z → Bool)
      (F : BitInput (Loc k t C) → Reg Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg Z),
      IsCirc (cmpCost k t n) F ∧
      ∀ x b,
        lawOf (F x (rket o)) out b = bern (cmpProb n x i j) b ∧
        lawOf (F x (rket o)) (fun z => !(out z)) b = bern (cmpProb n x j i) b

    (hC : CircuitRealises C (P k t)) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : repetitions k (epsval (mValue t) / (40 * t : ℕ)) ≤ n) :
    ∃ val : BitInput (Loc k t C) → ℝ,
      Runs (budget k t n (Fintype.card (Tests t C)))
        (fun x b => bern (val x) b) ∧
      (∀ x, Fkm k t C x = false →
        val x ≤ (Tval (mValue t) : ℝ) * epsval (mValue t)) ∧
      (∀ x, Fkm k t C x = true →
        1 - val x ≤ 2 * (mValue t : ℝ) / 2 ^ Tval (mValue t) +
          (Tval (mValue t) : ℝ) * epsval (mValue t) + epsval (mValue t))

    LE.le

        (HDiv.hDiv (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) ↑(HMul.hMul 40 t)))

      (QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs (QuarticQuery.Upper.budget k t n (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.Upper.Tests t C)))
        fun x b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (val x) b)
      (And
        (∀
          (x :
            QuarticQuery.BitInput
              (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),

                    (HPow.hPow 2 (QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t))))
                  (HMul.hMul (↑(QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)))
                    (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t))))
                (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)))))

    [Fintype Z] {w : ℕ} (e : Z ↪ Fin (w + 1)) (R : ReadSpec ι Z) :
    ∃ P : AdaptiveProgram ι w → AdaptiveProgram ι w, ∀ next,
      (P next).queryCap = 2 + next.queryCap ∧
